prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: premium illustrated drawing study for primary-school students, for Ma Liang's magic-brush story. A NEW landscape image approximately 1536x1024. No text anywhere.
Primary subject: one healthy, powerful yet gentle golden-brown Chinese farm ox in a full-body three-quarter side view, facing slightly toward the viewer and left. It occupies the left two-thirds of the composition, large enough to study its proportions. Four legs and four distinct dark cloven hooves clearly visible, anatomically plausible bovine joints, broad shoulder and deep chest, strong neck and forehead, two balanced curved horns, both ears, kind alert eyes, natural muzzle, long tail with a dark tuft clearly outlined away from the hind leg. Realistic cow anatomy, a dignified working animal, not a mascot, not toddler cartoon, not humanized. Warm tawny coat with fine visible short fur, cream muzzle, darker hooves and tail tuft. Plain simple halter if needed, no harness blocking shoulders or face. No wounds, no riding, no suffering.
Lower RIGHT third: two distinct traditional wooden plough tools displayed separately below and to the right of the animal, with clean whitespace between them and no overlap with any hoof. One is a narrow single-share wooden plough with a long draw-beam, one graspable handle, and one slim iron ploughshare at the front-bottom. The second is a visibly wider dual-share wooden plough with a sturdy wider timber frame, two side-by-side iron cutting shares and two handles. Tools must look physically buildable, joinery clear; neither has wheels, engines, sails, decorative machinery or people. Present each tool at the same three-quarter angle and slightly smaller scale than the animal so a child can compare the width and structure. The wide tool's TWO iron shares visibly spaced side-by-side, not a heap of unexplained wood. Do not attach tools to the ox.
Scene/backdrop: unbroken warm ivory hand-made paper with subtle fibers, generous breathing room above, delicate contact shadows under the animal and tools. No setting, fences, fields, plants, banners, cards, frames or labels. Animal and tools form one elegant still-life composition.
Art direction: finely rendered Chinese folktale picture-book art, tactile multilayer paper-sculpture depth, restrained malachite and azurite mineral-color accents in tiny shadow details, natural warm ochre and umber, delicate aged-gold contour accents, careful wood grain and iron surface. Soft daylight, clean readable silhouette, refined dimensional shading and beautiful hand-painted detail. Match the clean warm-paper educational illustration series of the water-lifting wheel / bamboo aqueduct / sluice-reservoir study. Not flat vector icons and not photography.
Constraints: exactly one ox, exactly two separate ploughs, exactly four hooves and two horns; all subjects fully within image borders; zero letters, writing, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, UI or arrows.

inspection.subject: One gentle tawny farm bovine, full four-hoof body, two horns, visible tail, shoulder and chest.
inspection.tools: Separate narrow single-share wood plough and wider twin-share plough. No overlap with hoof silhouette.
inspection.style: Warm paper and detailed dimensional illustration consistent with water-inventions reference.
inspection.text: No text, labels, numbers, watermark or UI.
